[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Technology: A new laptop, tablet, or smartphone accessory, like a wireless charging pad or a portable power bank.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Financial Help: Contribute to her college fund or help with a specific expense, like a laptop or textbooks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Inspirational Book: A motivational book, like "Oh, the Places You'll Go!" by Dr. Seuss or "The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People" by Stephen Covey.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Customized Mug or Journal: A personalized mug or journal with a motivational quote or her name.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Dream Big: A customized vision board or a "dream big" poster.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 13. Cash or Gift Cards: Cash or gift cards are always appreciated.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 14. Create a Memory Jar: A jar filled with notes, mementos, and memories from throughout her high school years.
